mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `org` (name, slug, description, background, owner_id, status, creator_id, is_deleted, version) VALUES (#{name}, #{slug}, #{description}, #{background}, #{ownerId}, #{status}, #{creatorId}, 0, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM `org` WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM `org` WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM `org` WHERE name = #{name} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT o.* FROM `org` o INNER JOIN org_member m ON o.id = m.tenant_id WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = 0 AND m.is_deleted = 0 AND o.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY o.gmt_create DESC

SELECT o.id, o.name, o.description, m.access_level FROM `org` o INNER JOIN org_member m ON o.id = m.tenant_id WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = 0 AND m.is_deleted = 0 AND o.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY o.gmt_create DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE `org` SET owner_id = #{newOwnerId}, modifier_id = #{modifierId}, gmt_modified = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND owner_id = #{oldOwnerId} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM `org` WHERE is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY id
